surfaces.name: Discover Root
surfaces.android_focus: M3 top app bar with embedded search pill; terracotta accent hero card; horizontal filter chips; one-handed bottom navigation
surfaces.ios_focus: Large title navigation with inline search bar; full-width editorial card with hairline divider; system material chips
surfaces.odisha_cultural_character: Deep sandstone canvas (#F5F2EB / #1A1612), authentic verified imagery, zero generic AI travel badges
surfaces.truth_assertions: Verified photo count badge, NO fake star ratings or synthetic reviews

surfaces.name: Place Detail
surfaces.android_focus: Predictive back container transform; tonal surface cards for facts; quick-access transit chip; bottom floating action
surfaces.ios_focus: Medium sheet detent transitioning to full screen; grouped list presentation; native MapKit preview thumbnail
surfaces.odisha_cultural_character: Dual-script English and Odia titles; cultural narrative essay block; artisan lineage credit
surfaces.truth_assertions: Distinct source photo count (no thumbnail duplication); media affordances appear only when verified asset exists; no fallback 3D or cross-destination video

surfaces.name: Map Selected Entity
surfaces.android_focus: M3 bottom sheet with drag handle; quick route button; transit stop pill chips with candidate status
surfaces.ios_focus: Interactive detent sheet (compact, medium, expanded); native system vibrancy background; SF Symbol icons
surfaces.odisha_cultural_character: Temple/heritage iconography with sandstone markers; verified geographic bounds
surfaces.truth_assertions: Zero fake vehicle tracking; candidate stops clearly marked with candidate disclosure; discontinuous transit gaps suppress polyline

surfaces.name: Plan (Constraint Input & Result)
surfaces.android_focus: Segmented button row for pace and transport preference; structured sliders; conversational refinement field at base
surfaces.ios_focus: Grouped form with native Pickers and Steppers; secondary natural language input field with clear keyboard handling
surfaces.odisha_cultural_character: Emphasis on cultural clusters (Golden Triangle, Mayurbhanj artisan belts, Chilika wetland)
surfaces.truth_assertions: Deterministic itinerary engine owns facts; AI input is network-required; offline mode disables conversational generation with clear banner

surfaces.name: Active Trip
surfaces.android_focus: Linear vertical timeline with M3 tonal milestone cards; external navigation intent launcher; manual completion toggle
surfaces.ios_focus: Card-based milestone stack with native checkmark buttons; transit countdown indicator; system sheet for essentials
surfaces.odisha_cultural_character: Temple darshan time windows, artisan workshop hours, regional weather precautions
surfaces.truth_assertions: Milestones completed manually or via external nav; no fake automated GPS arrival detection; offline trip bundle cached locally

surfaces.name: Transit Route Detail
surfaces.android_focus: Route badge header (CRUT Mo Bus); stop sequence list with official vs candidate stop indicators; departure time chips
surfaces.ios_focus: NavigationStack detail view with grouped stop table; schedule disclosure section; fare status card
surfaces.odisha_cultural_character: Bilingual stop names (English & Odia script); CRUT official route identity
surfaces.truth_assertions: All departures strictly Scheduled - HH:MM IST; fare status is strictly Fare information unavailable; unmapped geometry shows advisory banner with suppressed map polyline
